features.label: New Spain
features.source: The Viceroyalty of New Spain, to the independence of Mexico.

features.label: Guatemala (Spain)
features.source: The Captaincy General of Guatemala, governed from Antigua and then Guatemala City.

features.label: Louisiana (Spain)
features.source: Ceded by France in 1762 and handed back at San Ildefonso in 1800.

features.label: Florida (Spain)
features.source: Spanish Florida before Britain acquired it at the Treaty of Paris.

features.label: Florida (Spain)
features.source: Recovered from Britain in 1783 and given up to the United States under Adams-Onis.

features.label: New Granada (Spain)
features.source: The Viceroyalty of New Granada, represented here with Venezuela's modern extent until its declaration of independence.

features.label: New Granada (Spain)
features.source: The Viceroyalty of New Granada, represented here with the modern Colombian, Panamanian and Ecuadorian extent.

features.label: Río de la Plata (Spain)
features.source: The Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, represented with Paraguay's modern extent.

features.label: Río de la Plata (Spain)
features.source: The Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, represented with Argentina's modern extent.

features.label: Río de la Plata (Spain)
features.source: The Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata, represented with Uruguay's modern extent until Portuguese occupation.

features.label: Falkland Islands (Spain)
features.source: Spain administered Puerto Soledad after France's withdrawal until the settlement was evacuated during the independence wars.

features.label: Cuba (Spain)
features.source: Lost to the United States in the Treaty of Paris.

features.label: Puerto Rico (Spain)
features.source: Ceded to the United States in the Treaty of Paris.

features.label: Santo Domingo (Spain)
features.source: Retaken from France, then lost to Haiti. The two months of independent Spanish Haiti at the end are too brief to draw.

features.label: Santo Domingo (Spain)
features.source: Annexed at the Dominican president's invitation and abandoned after the War of Restoration.

features.label: Trinidad (Spain)
features.source: Taken by a British expedition and kept at Amiens.
